The testing of the "Sparkasse Demo Online Banking" application is complete. I have successfully executed navigation tests, verified account and list details, and inspected action buttons. All tests passed as expected.

### Test Summary:

| Test Case | Description | Verdict |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TC-001** | Navigate to Finanzplaner section | **PASS** |
| **TC-002** | Click and Verify Prognose page | **PASS** |
| **TC-003** | Click and Verify Fixkosten page | **PASS** |
| **TC-004** | Click and Verify Budgets page | **PASS** |
| **TC-005** | Click and Verify Schlagwörter page | **PASS** |
| **TC-006** | Go back to Finanzübersicht and check for balance details | **PASS** |
| **TC-007** | Verify account detail view for Privatgirokonto | **PASS** |
| **TC-008** | Verify Transfer button (navigate to transfer page) | **PASS** |

### Observations:
- **Navigation:** All main sections (Finanzplaner, Prognose, Fixkosten, Budgets, Schlagwörter) are accessible and load correctly with expected titles and content.
- **Data Display:** Account balances, transaction history, and charts (where applicable) are visible and populated with sample data.
- **Interaction:** Action buttons such as "Überweisung" functions correctly, opening the expected transaction form without unauthorized submission.
- **UI Consistency:** The application maintains a consistent design across all tested views.

No issues or bugs were identified during the testing process. The application appears functional and stable for the tested features.
